references.text: Misrefot-Majim is also mentioned here as a place where the Lord drove the enemies before Israel, demonstrating God's promise to dispossess the nations.
Sidon is mentioned as part of Asher's inheritance, linking to the promise that the Sidonians would be driven out.
God's promise to drive out the nations before Israel and the command to take the land as an inheritance.
God's promise to drive out the nations little by little from the land that Israel was to inherit.
The Lord repeats His promise to drive out the nations before Israel so they can take possession of the land as their inheritance.
Lebanon is mentioned as part of the promised land that Moses wished to see.
Mount Lebanon is described as part of the boundaries of the promised land.
